name: usw
description: Create, find, assess, and run text-first Markdown workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, find, assess, and run Markdown workflows.
interface.longDescription: Creates, finds, semantically assesses, and runs readable local or shared Markdown workflows through one model execution path with optional developer-local handoff state.
defaultPrompt: Use /usw-find-flow to find an existing workflow for this intent without running it.
Use /usw-assess-flow to assess a named workflow without running or changing it.
Run /usw-init to create a standalone workspace, then use usw-run-flow for a named Markdown workflow.
